# Medestra (ميديسترا) — Healthcare Growth, Medical Digital Marketing & AI Solutions Agency

> Medestra (https://medestra.me/) is a Healthcare Growth, Medical Digital Marketing & AI Solutions Agency empowering Hospitals, Supplement Companies, Cosmetics Brands, OBGYN Centers, Clinics, Pharmacies, and Medical Labs across Egypt, Saudi Arabia (KSA), Italy, and Latin America.

- **Languages Supported:** العربية (Arabic), English, Italiano (Italian), Español (Spanish)
- **Last Verified:** 2026-11-23

## Healthcare Sectors & Industries We Serve (القطاعات والجمهور المستهدف)
1. **Hospitals (المستشفيات والمجمعات الطبية الكبرى):** Full-funnel patient acquisition, Medical SEO, reputation management, and AI triage automation.
2. **Supplement Companies (شركات المكملات الغذائية والفيتامينات):** Compliant e-commerce growth, UGC & influencer campaigns, marketplace scaling, and supplement SEO.
3. **Cosmetics & Cosmeceuticals (شركات مستحضرات التجميل والعناية بالبشرة):** Performance marketing, brand positioning, and conversion-focused e-commerce growth.
4. **OBGYN Centers (مراكز النساء والتوليد والحقن المجهري):** Sensitive, high-trust medical content, local search visibility, and automated patient journey management.
5. **Clinics & Polyclinics (العيادات التخصصية والمراكز الطبية):** Patient booking growth, Meta & Google Ads, Google Maps Local SEO, and Meni Clinic CRM.
6. **Pharmacies (الصيدليات وسلاسل الصيدليات):** Omnichannel pharmacy sales growth, online pharmacy e-commerce, MePOS, and team sales training.
7. **Medical Labs (المعامل الطبية ومراكز التحاليل والأشعة):** High-intent local search capture, home-visit booking funnels, and WhatsApp patient CRM.

## Flagship Products & AI Solutions
- [BoBo Super Intelligence](https://medestra.me/bobo/): Autonomous Agentic AI system for clinical triage, 24/7 WhatsApp patient engagement, and booking automation across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Italy, and Latin America.
- [Meni Clinic CRM](https://medestra.me/meni-clinic/): Specialized polyclinic management CRM for appointments, medical history, waiting-lounge workflow, and financial reporting.
- [MePOS](https://medestra.me/products/): Pharmacy point-of-sale and inventory management system.

## Core Growth & Digital Marketing Services
- [Medical SEO & Content Marketing](https://medestra.me/service/content-marketing/): E-E-A-T compliant medical content, Google Maps Local SEO, and technical search optimization.
- [Medical Social Media & Paid Ads](https://medestra.me/service/social-media/): Compliant Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), Google Ads, and TikTok campaigns for healthcare.
- [Patient Customer Service & CRM](https://medestra.me/service/customer-service/): WhatsApp automation, call-center training, and patient retention systems.
- [Healthcare E-Commerce](https://medestra.me/service/ecommerce/): Growth management for supplement companies, cosmetics brands, online pharmacies, and medical devices.
- [Medical Web & Mobile Development](https://medestra.me/service/web-mobile/): High-speed, SEO-engineered websites and booking apps for healthcare providers.
- [Healthcare Marketing Training & Academy](https://medestra.me/academy/): Specialized courses including [Meta Ads Master Class](https://medestra.me/meta-ads-master/) and [Pharmacy Sales Mastery](https://medestra.me/pharmacy-sales/).
